inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A close piece of a pixel art battle stage background: the long blood red dune far away lit pink and gold by the dawn, a small dark pyramid on its top, rag tents and banners of the border camp in front of it. In it, far off: the giant sand shark of the red dunes: a huge pale sand coloured shark with a dark ridged back, rows of long teeth and small black eyes, swimming through the sand of the dune as if it were water, a wild animal, shown 3 times in 3 moments, in the same pixel art, colours and light as everything around it. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "one coherent pixel art scene, coherent pixel clusters, a clear readable creature, everything lit by the same light", "lighting": "Cool low dawn light from the left, soft violet shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ground in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#2a3e8a", "#7a8ac8", "#f0b0b8", "#f8d890", "#b04a4a", "#e2d6ba", "#c8b8a0", "#3e302c", "#7a6250", "#96703e", "#f07828"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "the long blood red dune far away lit pink and gold by the dawn, a small dark pyramid on its top, rag tents and banners of the border camp in front of it", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [612, 31, 800, 187], "desc": "the giant sand shark of the red dunes: a huge pale sand coloured shark with a dark ridged back, rows of long teeth and small black eyes, swimming through the sand of the dune as if it were water, a wild animal, only its tall dark dorsal fin and the ridge of its back cutting through the dune's surface, a wave of sand curling off it"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [300, 187, 687, 523], "desc": "the giant sand shark of the red dunes: a huge pale sand coloured shark with a dark ridged back, rows of long teeth and small black eyes, swimming through the sand of the dune as if it were water, a wild animal, bursting up out of the dune, its head and open jaws full of teeth rising above the ridge, sand pouring off its snout"}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [412, 718, 687, 937], "desc": "the giant sand shark of the red dunes: a huge pale sand coloured shark with a dark ridged back, rows of long teeth and small black eyes, swimming through the sand of the dune as if it were water, a wild animal, diving back into the dune tail first, its crescent tail fin up in the air, sand splashing"}]}}
